feature_rule: For each schema family pool its existing H96 and adjusted-state E104; retain common N36, context24 and NE36. Shared296 coordinates, no family identity input.
target: Existing future block_family_status at origin+8; known statuses supervise family heads, reference-ineligible families are absent
aggregation: Probability at least2 active families under conditionally independent Bernoulli outputs; exact capped-count recurrence
head: One shared additive logistic rule across all families; existing3-knot quadratic splines, scaling and group penalties
objective: Equal-person weighted mean observed-family BCE plus lambda times existing global-event BCE; L2 on shared coefficients; unpenalized intercept
selection: AUROC on the existing validation-participant fold; same folds as all development comparisons
scope: Development only; no Human Rhythms or College test access
prior_art: Count potentials and Bernoulli-count recurrences are established; Tarlow et al., UAI2012. This experiment tests structured target supervision within HNE, not novelty of the recurrence.
